critical_issues: First and last month due at signing ($4,400 upfront)
Early termination penalty of 1 month rent ($2,200)
Landlord can terminate with 60 days notice if selling/family move
strengths: Landlord pays water, sewer, garbage, heat
rationale: This is a reasonable, tenant-friendly lease that complies with Washington state tenant protections. The 12-month term, refundable deposits, cure period, and inspection limits are fair. Main concerns are the high upfront cost ($6,600) and landlord's ability to terminate for sale/family.
suggested_improvements: Negotiate to eliminate 'last month rent' requirement
Add relocation assistance if Landlord terminates
